apps_and_tools.name: Shopify
apps_and_tools.api_note: Shopify Admin REST API + GraphQL. Key: Settings > Apps > Develop apps.

apps_and_tools.name: Instagram
apps_and_tools.api_note: Meta Graph API, requires Business account + app review for some endpoints.

apps_and_tools.name: TikTok
apps_and_tools.api_note: TikTok for Developers API. Post creation limited; reading analytics easier.

apps_and_tools.name: Gmail
apps_and_tools.api_note: Gmail API via Google OAuth. Currently artbycruzcreations@gmail.com, migrating to erica@cruisecreations.com.

apps_and_tools.name: Google Calendar
apps_and_tools.api_note: Google Calendar API — full CRUD via OAuth.

apps_and_tools.name: Google Drive
apps_and_tools.api_note: Google Drive API — used for workshop photos, content library.

apps_and_tools.name: Google Forms
apps_and_tools.api_note: Google Forms + Sheets API — QR code form at workshops captures name, email, piece description.

apps_and_tools.name: Mailchimp
apps_and_tools.api_note: REPLACING — $50/month, barely used. Replace with AI-drafted email via Gmail.

apps_and_tools.name: ClassBento
apps_and_tools.api_note: No documented public API. Browser automation required (agent controls browser to log in and post/check workshops).

apps_and_tools.name: Canva
apps_and_tools.api_note: Canva Connect API — can generate designs from templates programmatically. Explore for flyer automation.

apps_and_tools.name: Photoshop
apps_and_tools.api_note: Desktop only. Can replace with Canva API or AI image generation (DALL-E, Ideogram) for social posts.

apps_and_tools.name: WhatsApp
apps_and_tools.api_note: WhatsApp Business API via Meta. Requires phone number verification + Meta Business app. Or use Twilio WhatsApp sandbox for dev.

apps_and_tools.name: iPhone Photos
apps_and_tools.api_note: iCloud API limited. Best approach: Google Photos app on iPhone with Backup & Sync enabled → auto-uploads camera roll to cloud.

channel_note: Erica prefers WhatsApp over Telegram/Discord/iMessage for agent communication. Need to set up WhatsApp Business API or Twilio sandbox.
budget_note: Currently pays $50/month for Mailchimp which she wants to replace. Target: cancel Mailchimp and redirect that $50 to agent infrastructure.
